items.details:
Use Recall on a passing raft, then board it while its movement reverses. Repeat the idea at the waterfall: ride a reversed raft upward rather than trying to swim against the current. Wait on safe ground while selecting a moving object so you do not drift away during preparation.

At the final gate, watch the two hands until they overlap. Use Recall on one hand at that moment so both move together, keeping the gate open long enough to pass. If they separate too soon, cancel Recall and wait for another overlap instead of forcing the door.

details_i18n.en:
Use Recall on a passing raft, then board it while its movement reverses. Repeat the idea at the waterfall: ride a reversed raft upward rather than trying to swim against the current. Wait on safe ground while selecting a moving object so you do not drift away during preparation.

At the final gate, watch the two hands until they overlap. Use Recall on one hand at that moment so both move together, keeping the gate open long enough to pass. If they separate too soon, cancel Recall and wait for another overlap instead of forcing the door.
details_i18n.pt:
Use Recall numa jangada que estiver passando e embarque enquanto ela se move ao contrário. Repita na cachoeira: suba numa jangada revertida em vez de tentar nadar contra a corrente. Espere em terreno seguro enquanto escolhe um objeto móvel para não se afastar durante a preparação.

Na última grade, observe os dois ponteiros até se sobreporem. Use Recall em um deles nesse instante para ambos girarem juntos e manterem a grade aberta. Se separarem cedo demais, cancele Recall e espere outra sobreposição em vez de tentar forçar a porta.

items.details:
Use Yunobo's rolling attack to break the legs supporting the boss. When it collapses, climb onto the body and strike the eye, then get away before the recovery throws you into danger. Keep enough stamina for the climb rather than spending it all while running around the arena.

In the ceiling phase, aim Yunobo up the curved arena wall so he reaches the boss overhead. If explosive rocks trap you, use his charge to open an escape before continuing the attack. Once the boss falls again, repeat the eye damage instead of attacking its armored body from the floor.

details_i18n.pt:
Use o rolamento de Yunobo para quebrar as pernas que sustentam o chefe. Quando ele cair, suba no corpo e ataque o olho; afaste-se antes de a recuperação lançar você numa situação perigosa. Guarde vigor para escalar, sem gastar tudo correndo pela arena.

Na fase do teto, mire Yunobo pela parede curva para ele alcançar o chefe acima. Se rochas explosivas cercarem você, use a investida dele para abrir uma saída antes de continuar. Quando o chefe cair novamente, repita os golpes no olho em vez de atacar a carapaça pelo chão.

items.details:
Remain aboard Mineru so the gloom-covered floor does not become the main threat. Face the enemy and block its attack, then answer with enough consecutive hits to knock it backward into the electric fence. Fence collisions are the important damage opportunity; isolated punches in the middle of the arena accomplish much less.

Keep a usable attachment on Mineru's arms and create distance if your guard is broken. When the enemy rises or attacks from range, use an attached ranged device if available, or defend until it returns within reach. Resume the block, stagger and fence-push sequence rather than leaving Mineru to duel on foot.

items.details:
If Robbie will not leave Lookout Landing, check the prerequisites rather than traveling repeatedly to an empty lab. Complete a regional dungeon and Josha's A Mystery in the Depths, following the underground statue route to the Great Abandoned Central Mine to obtain Autobuild. Return to Josha and repair Robbie's balloon.

Speak to Robbie again, meet him at Hateno and walk slowly during the Sensor demonstration. Follow its signal to the shrine in the cave below the lab, then report back. If that shrine was already discovered, Robbie can acknowledge the earlier progress instead of requiring another search.

details_i18n.en:

Se Robbie não sair do Posto de Observação, confira os requisitos em vez de visitar repetidamente um laboratório vazio. Fale novamente com Robbie, encontre-o em Hateno e caminhe devagar na demonstração do Sensor. Siga o sinal até o santuário na caverna abaixo do laboratório e volte para informar. Se o santuário já foi descoberto, Robbie pode reconhecer esse progresso sem exigir outra busca.
